# TextField

A labelled 48px text input for forms (sign in, sign up, password reset, settings).

`TVTracker.TextField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.TextField label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.TextField" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Labelled 48px input. Password fields get a show/hide toggle. Focus uses accent-mark; errors use danger.
